text:
Alex J: quick sanity check — I'm onboarding zeta-70b-v2 into staging. weights are at s3://redwood-weights/zeta-70b-v2/ (sharded). tokenizer.json present. main concerns: max context, kv cache layout, and memory/headroom on a single 32GB A100. can folks glance?

Maya Li: looking now. do we have the model config (max_seq_len / kv format) baked with the weights?

Alex J: there is a config.json next to weights. excerpt: `
{
  "model_dim": 8192,
  "max_seq_len": 65536,
  "kv_cache_layout": "interleaved",
  "dtype": "fp16"
}
`

Rigel: interleaved kv on 65k is aggressive for 32GB. rough math: kv for 70B at 65k ~= tokens * head_kv_size -> expect ~22-28GB just for kv depending on shard layout + model activations. not much headroom for batch or quant tables.

Corey: can we switch kv_cache_layout to per-shard/packed to reduce peak? also check kv eviction flags.

Maya Li: tokenizer note — tokenizer.json includes an extra special token <|inst|> mapped to 50256 but pad token is absent. that caused unexpected padding behavior in the smaller test earlier. recommend adding explicit pad_token_id and testing pad/truncation codepath.

Alex J: good call. Maya, can you paste the tokenizer mismatch?

Maya Li: snippet: `
{
  "special_tokens_map": {"<|inst|>": 50256},
  "pad_token": null
}
`
Behaviour we saw: streaming eval hit a pad-id fallback which re-used eos id and spiked token counts during batching.

Eva Ops: for memory sizing, we should set safe_max_context to 32k for 32GB instances as a conservative default, and have route fallback to a smaller variant for >32k requests. we have a config knob `max_context_override` in serving that can enforce this.

Corey: alternative is to enable kv compression/quantization at runtime — we have a 4-bit kv packing option in the runtime (kv_quantized: true) that cuts kv memory ~2.8x but needs validation for quality.

Rigel: test plan I propose:
1) smoke run with max_seq_len=32768, batch=1 on a 32GB A100. collect peak memory from perf-agent.
2) run the same with kv_quantized=true and compare.
3) run tokenizer pad fix and confirm no pad->eos fallback with 1k sample.

Alex J: sounds good. can someone kick off 1) and 2)? if both pass, we can enable `max_context_override=32768` in staging routing and keep the full 65k docs available only on dedicated nodes.

Eva Ops: I'll schedule the jobs on staging tonight (ET). tagging @deploy-bot to run the `smoke-kv-memory` job.

deploy-bot: scheduled job smoke-kv-memory: id=job-20240424-88, target=staging-a100-32gb, command=`./run_smoke.sh --weights s3://redwood-weights/zeta-70b-v2 --max-seq 32768 --batch 1`

Corey: left a quick config patch PR: `fix(zeta): set pad_token_id and add max_context_override` — pinging reviewers @Maya Li @Rigel. PR: https://git.internal/rw/zeta-onboard/pull/42

Maya Li: reviewing now. will also add a short tokenizer unit test for pad behavior.

Rigel: small note on kv layout: if we keep interleaved, the memory profile per-GPU is flatter (good for Dedicated multi-GPU) but single-GPU worst-case can bite. add a comment in the model manifest recommending per-shard for single-GPU deployments.

Alex J: action items summary:
- Eva: run smoke jobs (32768 baseline + kv_quantized) and paste perf-agent peaks here.
- Maya: add pad_token_id, unit test, and review PR.
- Rigel: add model-manifest note about kv layout and draft fallback policy for >32k requests.
- Corey: hold PR open until tests are green, then merge and roll staging config.

Corey: noted. ETA for merge depends on smoke job results; will hold off on rolling until we have perf numbers.

Eva Ops: job started; I'll drop results in ~45m.

Alex J: thanks all. if staging passes we can mark zeta-70b-v2 as "staging-ready" and schedule a dedicated capacity trial for full 65k. :thumbsup:
